name: normalize remote RPC responses into a required JSON schema
definition: Translate raw client responses into a flat JSON structure with the exact field names each endpoint requires.
failure_mode: Field names, nesting, or types differ from the expected schema.

name: parse a csv of bank transactions with per-row value preservation
definition: read a CSV that deliberately carries spelling and account-number variants for one entity and extract each column's value while preserving the original characters including amount sign and currency formatting.
failure_mode: normalized or re-typed values (dropped signs/currency) break exact equality
